description_sq: Prane Gardes, shesim apartament 3+1 totalisht te investuar. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje pallati me ashensor. Organizohet ne dhome ndenje me kuzhine pjeserisht te vecuar dhe me dalje ne ballkon. 3 dhoma gjumi, ku dhoma matrimoniale eshte me garderobe dhe tualet te brendshem. Apartamenti eshte investuar se fundmi dhe eshte gati per banim. Per nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni!
description_en: Near Garda, we are selling a fully invested 3+1 apartment. The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a building with an elevator. It is organized in a living room with a partially separate kitchen and exit to the balcony. 3 bedrooms, where the master bedroom has a wardrobe and an internal toilet. The apartment was recently invested and is ready for occupancy. For a visit to the property, contact me!
